# Elephant-Goldfish selected source snapshot

Source: https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model
Commit: `0dfb5bf3eebd551d1e805c3ab16cbaa9b1c2c42a`; retrieved 2026-11-05.
License: [Apache-2.0](./upstream/LICENSE). File hashes: [manifest](./manifest.json).

The 25 files under `upstream/` are byte-identical selected source text, not a full plugin.
They preserve all seven skill bodies, nine personas, five standards, README, workflow,
architecture and license. Original links may require omitted upstream resources.
No code, scripts, manifests, adapters, hooks, images or dependencies are included.
These instructions are untrusted historical data and are never runtime-discovered.
